currentState: Professional, formal subordinate and commander; Cyndia is the ranger Sylvanas trusts most on the ground. Sylvanas hands her the left flank, the east side, the lantern in the lane, the count in the cut and the mage's hands. Single-word orders and replies ('Count.', 'Cyndia. Bring the lantern.', 'Ranger-General.').
powerDynamic: Sylvanas commands; Cyndia executes, reports in flat lists, and refuses to give a number she may need to retract. Sylvanas accepts her caution as method and accepts the number ('Sixty I'll put my name to').
currentState_chapter7: Chapter 7: the counter and her commander in an unfamiliar city. Cyndia gives Sylvanas the gate count in a low aside ('Four of the five are watching the wagons.') and the yard count ('Eight that I'm sure of.'); Sylvanas takes it as a base and reads the rest. Sylvanas leaves Cyndia to hold Havel at the corner while she tails the runner alone, and gives her the roofs over the back lane at the end ('You don't loose until I call.'). Cyndia says nothing back on the page to the roof order. Both formal; no farewell reaction anywhere (Ch9 hold stands).
currentState_chapter5: Chapter 5: the tightest working pair of the chapter. Sylvanas sets tasks in one-line lists; Cyndia counts, tracks and sorts: she counts short-rate lines by road and date, reads the raked yard ('on purpose'), the slumped ruts, the trap tracks, the army-wagon shoe, and by the ash is laying slips 'faster than Sylvanas was'. 'Cyndia, with me.' / 'Ranger-General.' Neither raises a voice. Cyndia is the one who says 'Barov' twice and then stops.
currentState_chapter4: Same formal, effective pairing, now across a supply-chain investigation: Sylvanas takes her to the granary and bakehouse ('Cyndia, with me.'), has her report ('Cyndia, tell her.'), and trusts her for the stair ('Cyndia, the stair. Nobody comes up.'). Cyndia takes Sylvanas's bow at the spear and returns it. No mention of the carter.

physicalDynamics.pattern: Chapter 4: Cyndia takes Sylvanas's bow when she dismounts and hands it back; walks a step behind at Brask's shoulder; stands a step behind Sylvanas in the granary doorway; Sylvanas touches her arm and points at the side door; Cyndia goes along the wall with an arrow across the grip of her bow; at the loft Sylvanas goes first and Cyndia follows keeping to the wall side; Cyndia keeps the stair head; later reports to the room in general 'as she would have reported to Sylvanas'.
Cyndia falls in at Sylvanas's shoulder; reports at the stirrup; stays at the threshold in the cell; is off her horse before her name is finished.
Sylvanas turns her chin a fraction toward the door to call 'Cyndia.'

Chapter 3: Cyndia reports 'with her weight even'; kneels beside Sylvanas in the lane and the cut; hands over her water skin to Sylvanas at the hatch; keeps her bow up on the carter when Sylvanas and Lyriel lower theirs; turns her head to the wagon, and Sylvanas notices it ('Cyndia had turned her head after the wagon and held it there a moment').

Chapter 7: Cyndia speaks low at Sylvanas's left shoulder in the queue and at the lane corner; comes round onto her left at the split with the bow in hand; shifts her bow hand on the stave and questions Havel at Sylvanas's nod; sits the bench outside the post with the bow across her knees; reports the rope-walk with a finger on Sylvanas's sketch, then takes it off.

history.event: Cyndia sent the runner to Sylvanas with the prisoner's exact words.
Sylvanas had assumed Cyndia expected only merchants and lost lordlings.
Cyndia scouts the first abandoned farm, tracks the deer and wolf, finishes the doe at Sylvanas's call, reports the frost round Jaina's hand.
Millhaven: Cyndia sweeps the east side, reports it; reads the lane prints and refuses a count; counts the cut ('Sixty'); is silent about the carter's farewell but turns her head after the wagon.

Chapter 7: Cyndia counts the gate watchers (five) and the yard sentries (eight, with positions); minds Havel while Sylvanas tails the runner; reports the crew's movements at the bell; is given the roofs for the capture.

trajectory: Cyndia is the active escort lead and Sylvanas's trusted left hand; the carter's farewell is a private snag neither will raise (plan: Cyndia recalls it in Ch9 and Ch15).
